title: Eastern census and local-reception lane, batch 5: dated official enumeration crosswalk, named Albanian and Macedonian gaps, Lungro Holy Week book leads, a further defective 1646 copy

uses.finding: The latest official named enumeration reachable is Cardinal Sandri's list of 15 November 2016 (SICO 2015–2016, printed p. 325, re-viewed as a page image): 6 patriarchal, 4 major archiepiscopal, 5 metropolitan and 8 other names, 23 in all, which map one-to-one onto the 23 research slots (including Albanian, Russian, Belarusian, Macedonian, Bulgarian, Greek, Italo-Albanian, and Croatia with Serbia as one). The census method now names this list as the latest official named enumeration found (a list in the Prefect's lecture printed in SICO, not a canonical act) and keeps the July 2016, 2017 and 2019 groupings separate. A newly acquired Dicastery-linked SICO 2017–2018 volume (722 pp.) and the SICO 2019–2020 volume contain no named enumeration by text-layer and page-density searches.
uses.limit: A 2016 list is not a 2026 census. The Annuario Pontificio is subscription-only and was not accessed; its December 2025 presentation PDF returned HTTP 404. Secondary 2025–2026 lists (including a partial fetch of the Catholic World Report article) were not used as evidence.
uses.next_sources: Annuario Pontificio 2026 named section (print); any later Dicastery or Holy See document naming all Churches.

uses.finding: A gap-only tradition eastern-local-round2:albanian and gap eastern-local-round2:albanian-book now name the missing Elbasan celebrant book and list the searches. OPAC SBN any-field queries (Papamihali, Scarpelli Pietro, mesha hyjnore, Gojarti, Gojarit, Joan Gojarti liturgjia, shqiperia bizantine liturgjia, Elbasan with all 21 records screened) return BVE0501507 as the only liturgical record; Internet Archive metadata found no Albanian Catholic service book.
uses.limit: The National Library of Albania catalogue API returned unusable responses instead of search results and could not be searched. BVE0501507 remains uninspected. No Orthodox Albanian or Italo-Albanian book was transferred.
uses.next_sources: Grottaferrata copy of BVE0501507; ACCO Prot. 441/28; Greek College correspondence; the Albanian national catalogue when usable.

uses.finding: Gap-only tradition eastern-local-round2:macedonian and gap eastern-local-round2:macedonian-book added. Nineteen katolici.mk WordPress queries (language, liturgy, translation and book terms) and twelve posts read: dated hierarchical Liturgies and the 2 December 2018 inauguration of the eparchy are reported (the eparch calls the community particular by language and rite) but no post names the celebrant book or the language of celebration.
uses.limit: COBISS.MK presented a proof-of-work bot challenge (2026-10-22T10:08:58Z) and was not attempted. The 9 December 2009 approval names translated liturgies only, so no approval-dated stage was created: without an identified book or evidenced use it would contradict the admission rule in time-machine §11.
uses.next_sources: 2009 Литургикон holding record and title leaves; original pages of the 2024 jubilee monograph; a dated announcement naming the book or language.

uses.finding: OPAC SBN identifies Lungro's eparchial Holy Week books, Grande e Santa Settimana e Santa Domenica di Pasqua: 1977 (CSA0027251, VIII+264 p.), 1989 (FOG0195240, 219 p.) and 2016 in two volumes (VIA0340273, 518+622 p.). The eparchy's own report dates to 18 March 2016 the presentation at the diocesan museum of a two-volume work of that title wanted by Bishop Donato Oliverio; its identity with the 2016 record rests on title, year and volume count. These are added as origin-review records italo-albanian-lungro-holyweek1977, -1989 and -2016. The eparchy's profile of 26 February 2026, a modern self-description and not the 1968 decree, an approval or book evidence, restates Arbëresh as a liturgical language since 1968 beside Greek, with Chrysostom the most widespread official text, Basil on ten fixed days and James rare.
uses.limit: None of the books was seen. All are catalogued in Italian; languages printed, contents (including whether any Eucharistic service is included), approval and altar use are unknown, and an Italian translation would fall under the deferred translation scope. The 2026 profile names no book or decree day. The 1999 faithful's Chrysostom (PUG0004702) was already recorded as byzantine-greek-lungro1999-faithful and was not duplicated.
uses.next_sources: Title, contents and approval leaves of the 2016 volumes (Rende or Venice copies); Bollettino 3 (1968) pp. 14–16; Piana 2006 Ieratikon leaves.

uses.finding: A Greek web search for the approval of the 2014 Papadimitriou Euchologion found nothing relevant.
uses.limit: No receiving edition, adoption act or dated celebration with a named book; Istanbul not searched.

uses.finding: The Ukrainian Catholic University digital library item 156 is a public IIIF copy catalogued as the Lviv 1646 Sluzhebnik (Mshanets church provenance), leaves 14–297 and two unnumbered (570 canvases, CC BY-NC). Canvases 3 (leaf 14, Great Vespers), 563, 566, 568 and 570 (daily and festal dismissals ending in the Nativity dismissal) were viewed. The record cites Zapasko and Isaievych no. 352 for the edition ([6], 308, [2] leaves) and a foreword by Arsenii Zhelyborskyi dated 23 August 1646. Added as source hungarian-src-ucu-1646-copy.
uses.limit: It lacks title, opening leaves and colophon, so it gives neither the requested title nor colophon images; it has no Hungarian provenance and says nothing about Nyírderzs. The foreword date is reported by the catalogue, not viewed. Google Books returned HTTP 429; Polona has no copy among first results; no source dates Fr. István Zolcsák's Nyírderzs incumbency. It is less complete than the Czech copy A 003340 already recorded (305 surviving folios; its catalogue describes the preliminaries, leaves 306–307 and the terminal leaves as missing), so it is not a fuller copy; its edition identity rests on the provider's citation of Zapasko and Isaievych no. 352.
uses.next_sources: Szent Atanáz copies Ant10467 and Ant10560 ownership leaves; a Hajdúdorog or Nyíregyháza schematism; the 1920 and 1949 originals.

uses.finding: Exarchate pages re-read (2007 Holy Week collection, Burgas 2005 combined book) without source or approval statements. A web search found a study of the 1985 Bulgarian Orthodox Synodal Sluzhebnik; the gap now warns that this different 1985 book must not be conflated with Eldarov's Rome 1985 Sluzhebnik.
uses.limit: No title, approval or source leaf of the Catholic books.

uses.finding: A further Arabic web search found no scan or title leaves of the synodal Book of the Divine Liturgy.
A Russian web search found no parish record naming a Roman Slavonic Liturgikon in use; a Vulgata menologion study (Semenenko-Basin and Caprio) is a calendar lead only.

gap_dispositions.evidence: Greek web search for the 2014 Euchologion approval.
SBN Holy Week catalogue leads (contents unseen) and website searches; no altar book, approval or dated adoption resolved.

A further defective copy catalogued as the 1646 edition (UCU item 156), less complete than the recorded Czech copy, was found, but it bears on edition control, not on dated Nyírderzs ownership or use; Zolcsák incumbency searches negative.
gap_dispositions.remaining: Dated Nyírderzs ownership or use; Kriva/Krive identity; inspected M–920 leaves.

gap_dispositions.evidence: Exarchate pages re-read; Orthodox 1985 Sluzhebnik caution added.
Lungro website and SBN searches; 2026 eparchy profile and Holy Week book leads recorded; no decree original or exemplar.
gap_dispositions.remaining: Original 1968 decree; printing identity; Greek exemplar; receiving copies.

gap_dispositions.evidence: Piana website, SBN and web searches.
gap_dispositions.remaining: Exact Piana celebrant book, approval, implementation.

gap_dispositions.evidence: UCU 1646 copy found; no Hungarian provenance or dated use.
gap_dispositions.remaining: A supported sequence of exact books in use.

gap_dispositions.evidence: No new route to the 1920/1949 originals or circulars was tried beyond a failed Google Books request for the 1646 book.

remaining_gaps: Census: a current (2026) official named enumeration; the latest official named one found is dated 15 November 2016.
Albanian: eastern-local-round2:albanian-book (exact Elbasan celebrant book, approval, exemplar, dated use).
Macedonian: eastern-local-round2:macedonian-book (2009 Литургикон title, imprint, approval, exemplar; dated use naming book or language).
Italo-Albanian: original 1968 decree; Lungro Holy Week volumes' languages, contents and approval; Piana 2006 Ieratikon approval and use; OCR of 1990s Lajme scans.
Greek: receiving editions and adoption at Athens and Istanbul.
Hungarian: dated Nyírderzs use; M–920 ownership leaves; 1646 title/colophon images (the UCU copy lacks both); 1920/1949 originals; later sequence.
Bulgarian, Melkite, Russian: as in eastern-local-round2.
limits: No stage or transition was added: every new item is a catalogue record, an eparchial news report or profile, or a defective copy of an already-dated edition, which the evidence rules admit only as inventory leads or sources. The two new gap-only traditions document missing books and searches; they claim no book state. No Macedonian approval-dated stage was created because neither a book nor use is evidenced. Downloads of 1990s Lajme scans (about 380 MB) were not searchable without Italian OCR and remain unexamined. Derived page renderings and text layers are in scratch and not listed separately. No outreach, account, purchase or access-control bypass: a proof-of-work bot challenge (COBISS.MK), HTTP 429 (Google Books), HTTP 404 (Annuario presentation PDF) and a subscription wall (Annuario) were recorded and not circumvented; the unusable Albanian catalogue API was not probed further and its responses were not retained.

independent_review.reviewer: independent batch-5 cold reviewer, distinct from the lane author and the coordinator
independent_review.scope: Reviewed lane commit a7e0604cc against base a17f42c7e; the lane added two gap-only traditions, two gaps, three origin-review records and seven sources, and no stage, transition or narrowed gap. Re-fetched and compared by hash: SICO 2015-2016 (pp. 317 and 325 rendered and viewed; the 15 November 2016 list of 6+4+5+8 = 23 names maps one-to-one onto the 23 slots), SICO 2017-2018 and 2019-2020 from the Dicastery-linked Drive files (own density and count-phrase scans: no named enumeration), the Dicastery publications page, Lungro posts 7660 and 5851, eight OPAC SBN full records, the UCU item 156 record and manifest with canvases 3, 563 and 570 viewed; re-ran the SBN Elbasan, Internet Archive and katolici.mk Литургикон searches and read katolici.mk post 31987. Checked all 145 acquisition hashes, the worklog hash, ownership, field boundaries and path hygiene. Corrections: the UCU copy is no longer called a fuller copy (the recorded Czech copy A 003340 is more complete) and its edition identity is marked catalogue-cited; the Lungro Holy Week records lose a generic expectation of Eucharistic contents, take research_priority language-and-origin-review and the catalogue imprints, and the 2016 presentation is no longer attributed to the bishop or silently identified with the SBN record; the census list is the latest official named enumeration found, a lecture list rather than a controlling act; the Macedonian scope no longer presupposes an existing celebrant book or earlier Slavonic books; Macedonian search counts corrected to nineteen queries and twelve posts; the misattributed Google Books 429 removed from the Hungarian originals gap; PUG0004702 identified as the already recorded 1999 book; SBN holdings and the Piana booklet wording corrected; the Lungro 2026 profile labelled a modern self-description in every summary; a third-party server fault reworded. Not checked: the Melkite, Russian and Greek web searches, the Lungro and Piana site searches and Polona beyond their recorded text; the unexamined 1990s Lajme scans; original book leaves (none were available); generated browser data.
